ideal: Every change lands as a small pull request or stack layer, passes checks and one Review: MERGE on few tokens, and queues under 10 minutes.

sources.title: How the Claude Code team does code review
GitHub Changelog: Stacked pull requests generally available
GitHub Docs: Creating a pull request template for your repository

quality: Gates held at the merged head, green first, no Blocking finding, small or stacked, the template filled, never reworked.
speed: Merged within the hour at the median, a verdict within minutes, the final push merged in minutes, the queue under 10.
consumption: Few review tokens and few runner minutes per merge, in the queue and the lane.
